items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He recorded me, and he did not pay for the record session: Cal Tjader, Ron Crotty, and myself.

ctx.x: When you began studying with him, how did he react to your music and to jazz?

[ ] class, the octet was born, when he said, “How many of you in this class play jazz?” Five of us raised our hands. We thought that was going to be the end of – like any other conservatory. He said, “I’d like you to write your counterpoint and your compositions for jazz instrumentation, if you want to.” That’s how the octet came in.
Paul Desmond and Cal Tjader came over from San Francisco State any way their [?]. Have you ever heard the octet? I know you’ve heard it. So you know the members of it.
